subject: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive (MedLytics)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@medlytics.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive (MedLytics)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and latency for your on-prem pipeline while keeping model parity with current QoE.
- Key constraints: HIPAA controls, VPC-only access, nightly batch windows, and a few custom tokenization quirks in your preprocessing.
- Stakeholders: your ML lead (Rajiv) + infra (Priya) + product (you).

Next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive where our ML/infra team can walk through architecture, run a quick perf baseline plan, and align on integration touchpoints. Proposed agenda:
1) 5–10m: goals & success criteria
2) 15–20m: your architecture overview (Rajiv)
3) 30–45m: demo / performance discussion with our infra team (Camila + Dylan)
4) 10–15m: integration plan & next actions / mutual action plan review

Available slots we have next week (all PT):
- Tue, Mar 2 — 11:00–12:30 PT (60–90m)
- Thu, Mar 4 — 09:00–10:30 PT
- Thu, Mar 4 — 14:00–15:30 PT

If none of those work feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/medlytics-tech-deep-dive

Prep / requests for the session:
- Please include Rajiv + Priya on the invite (so we can dive into infra details).
- If possible, share a short architecture diagram and a sample inference payload or small test dataset ahead of time.

Attendees from our side (planned):
- Marissa Cole — AE (owner)
- Camila Reyes — Solutions Engineer (infra + perf)
- Dylan Brooks — Technical Lead (model serving / KV cache)

I attached a draft mutual action plan for the engagement. Let me know which slot you prefer and if you want the session to be 60 vs 90 minutes.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf

- We prefer a 60-minute slot to keep it focused, but could extend to 90 if useful.
- Is recording the session OK? We want to share with a few teammates who can't make it.

Available times that work for Rajiv + Priya (all ET):
- Tue, Mar 2 — 2:00–3:30 ET (this maps to your 11:00–12:30 PT slot)

Best,

Attendees (confirmed):
- MedLytics: Sarah Lin (Product), Rajiv Kumar (ML Lead), Priya Patel (Infra)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Camila Reyes (Solutions Eng), Dylan Brooks (Technical Lead)

What we'll cover and a couple quick asks:
- Rajiv: if you can send the architecture diagram and a sample inference payload (or S3 path) by end of day Mon, that would help Camila/Dylan prepare targeted perf experiments.
- Priya: if there are network restrictions (VPN / firewall rules) that could affect remote testing, please flag so we can plan a jump box or on-prem options.
- Recording: yes, recording is fine — we'll keep it internal to the working group.

I've attached a short pre-demo checklist with items for both infra and ML (keys, S3 access, sample payload sizes). If anything else is needed, we'll follow up in the thread.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Marissa
